verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of a crawler setting for honoring robots.txt or for automatically throttling to a target site's rate limits. The crawl docs ([firecrawl-gh-3], [firecrawl-docs-21]) only describe crawling whole sites. One community comment [firecrawl-comm-8] implies site owners can disallow a 'FireCrawlAgent' user agent, but that is an unverified site-owner-side remark, not a user-configurable capability. Nothing addresses rate-limit handling.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can configure the crawler to respect robots.txt rules and target-site rate limits automatically
